Name: Fairy Garden Decorations for CF
Author: wabiii
Description:
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds a set of cute, fairy-themed garden decorations to your game. [/size]
[*][size=3]They can be bought from Robins shop.[/size]
[*][size=3][b][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=description]Custom furniture[/url]﻿ must be installed for the items to appear in the shop.[/s][/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]CF UPDATED VERSION [url=https://github.com/Platonymous/Stardew-Valley-Mods]HERE[/url]﻿[/b][/size]
[/list]
[size=3]  [/size][size=4]Objects included: [/size][size=3]Mushroom chairs, decorative mushrooms, flower pots, tables, trellises, a flowery fence, and a birdbath.

[/size]    [u][size=4]Issues:[/size][/u][size=3] [/size][size=2]The large mushroom chair can only be sat on from the sides or behind, this is because of the size.
[/size]                     [size=2]Custom furniture makes it so custom objects cannot be placed on tables.[/size]
[size=2]                      [/size][b]CF can duplicate and become stuck, especially when using stack everything mods.
[/b][size=2]                      [/size]

[size=3]1.1.0: [/size][size=2]Fixed some sprites and made the fence endpieces 1 tile wide instead of half a tile. Added item descriptions[/size]
[size=2]  [/size]
[size=2]♡ Thanks to Steph for help with shading the table and to [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url][size=2] for showing me how to make CF packs ♡[/size]

[size=3][b]If you'd like to consider supporting my work I now have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/abiwabiii]Patreon ^0^ [/url][/b][/size]
